rule_a: Students must maintain at least 75% attendance in a course to be eligible for the corresponding end-semester examination, unless a specific approved exception applies.
rule_b: For the controlled corpus, an approved medical-leave case may be considered for examination eligibility when course attendance is at least 60%.
test_condition: Student has 68% attendance and approved medical leave.

topic: Subsequent campus recruitment after accepting an offer
rule_a: A student who has accepted a campus placement offer shall not participate in any subsequent campus recruitment process.
rule_b: A student who has accepted an offer may participate in a subsequent campus recruitment process until the date on which the student formally joins the organisation.
test_condition: Student accepted an offer but has not formally joined the organisation.

rule_a: A controlled administrative notice states that scholarship renewal applications must be received by 15 August.
rule_b: A separate project scholarship memorandum states that scholarship renewal applications submitted by 20 August will be accepted without late classification.
test_condition: Student asks for the final non-late scholarship renewal date.
